mentions.name: AllZonefiles.io
mentions.description: A domain-data hub that aggregates and serves large-scale zone files, currently covering ~354M domains across 1,575 zones, including ~114M domains from 317 ccTLDs. Work is under way on an extended dataset parsed from WHOIS adding create/expire/update timestamps, NS records, and IANA registrar info. Built with Go, bare-metal Linux, PostgreSQL, and Bootstrap 5, it is designed to make downloading and maintaining the most complete domain lists automated and predictable.
mentions.problem: Obtaining complete domain lists normally involves manual registry workflows and fragmented sources; collecting ccTLD zone data was the hardest part operationally.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m continuing to work on AllZonefiles.io — a domain-data hub that aggregates and serves large-scale zone files. Right now it covers ~354M domains across 1,575 zones, including ~114M domains from 317 ccTLDs, which turned out to be the hardest part operationally.
